title: Adversarial Multi-Agent Peer Review: Simulating Conference Committee Decisions
summary: Human peer review suffers from variance and subjective bias. We formalize an adversarial multi-agent peer review committee consisting of three specialized reviewer agents (Theory, Empirical, Novelty) and an Area Chair. Evaluating 400 published ICLR manuscripts, the committee achieves a 0.86 Spearman correlation with actual conference decisions, generating actionable rebuttal roadmaps that improve borderline submissions.
